description: Number of Health Facilities by Type of Health Facility is a data set listed in Qatar Open Data Portal (data.gov.qa), an open data portal (Opendatasoft), published or maintained by National Planning Council. This dataset provides information about the number of health facilities in Qatar, categorized by type of health facility such as government hospitals, private hospitals, healthcare centers, and specialized clinics. It supports health infrastructure monitoring and sectoral analysis for planning and development. Coverage: Qatar. The portal files it under the publisher National Planning Council. Its tags are health, facilities, qatar, hospitals, clinics. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support health-facility access and emergency-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-qa-portal.
